findings.issue_text: [High/bug] pkg/expr/reader.go:193-198 — `enableSqlExpressions` always returns `false`: when the flag is disabled it returns `false`, and when the flag is enabled it also returns `false` (the second branch `return false`), so SQL expressions are permanently rejected regardless of the feature toggle.

[High/bug] pkg/expr/sql/db.go:14-24 — The replacement `DB` implementation stubs every method with `errors.New("not implemented")`, but call sites in `pkg/expr/sql/parser.go` and `pkg/expr/sql_command.go` treat it as a working replacement for the removed `go-duck` library; `TablesList`, `RunCommands`, and `QueryFramesInto` will always fail, silently breaking any SQL expression path that reaches them.

[Medium/bug] pkg/expr/reader.go:129-131 — The feature check returns a generic hardcoded error `"sqlExpressions is not implemented"` before even parsing the query, rather than a proper "feature disabled" error message; combined with issue 1, users with the feature enabled get a confusing, incorrect error.

[Medium/test_gap] pkg/expr/sql/db.go / pkg/expr/sql_command.go — No tests were updated or added for the new stub DB or the new feature-gating path in `ReadQuery`; existing tests for `TablesList`/`Execute` will now fail or are removed with no replacement coverage.

[Low/doc_defect] pkg/expr/sql/db.go:1-26 — `QueryFramesInto` ignores its `frames` and `f` parameters and `RunCommands`/`TablesList` return stub errors; there's no TODO/issue reference documenting when real functionality will land, making this a silent functional regression in the API contract.

[Low/data] pkg/go.work.sum & go.sum — The `go-duck` dependency was dropped from `go.mod`/`go.sum` while the code still depends on its behavior (now stubbed); mixing dependency removal with non-functional stubs risks breaking any consumer (e.g., downstream workspace modules) that relied on DuckDB-backed SQL parsing.

adjudication.rationale: In `pkg/expr/reader.go` the new SQL path does `enabled := enableSqlExpressions(h)` and immediately returns `fmt.Errorf("sqlExpressions is not implemented")` when `!enabled`, before `iter.ReadVal(q)` parses the query. The helper `enableSqlExpressions` as added always returns `false` (it returns `false` in both branches, and also inverts the flag with `!h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(...)`), so SQL expressions will always hit this generic error even when the feature flag is enabled, making the error confusing/incorrect as the finding states.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces new behavior and surfaces new error paths (e.g., `ReadQuery` now checks `enableSqlExpressions(h)` for `QueryTypeSQL` and can return an error; `pkg/expr/sql/db.go` adds a new `sql.DB` stub whose methods all return `errors.New("not implemented")`, and `SQLCommand.Execute` now calls `db.QueryFramesInto`). No test files (`*_test.go`) are added or modified in the shown diff, so there is no accompanying coverage for these new code paths. However, the claim that “existing tests … will now fail or are removed” cannot be verified from the diff alone.

adjudication.rationale: The diff replaces the prior `github.com/scottlepp/go-duck/duck` implementation with a new `pkg/expr/sql/db.go` `DB` whose methods `TablesList`, `RunCommands`, and `QueryFramesInto` all return `errors.New("not implemented")` (and don’t use their inputs). The updated callers now use this stub: `pkg/expr/sql/parser.go` calls `NewInMemoryDB().RunCommands(...)`, and `pkg/expr/sql_command.go` calls `sql.NewInMemoryDB().QueryFramesInto(...)`, which will now fail at runtime whenever invoked. This is a concrete behavior break introduced by the diff (regardless of TODO/issue references).

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the real DuckDB-backed implementation (`github.com/scottlepp/go-duck/duck`) from `go.mod`/`go.sum` and replaces it with a new `pkg/expr/sql/db.go` where `RunCommands`, `TablesList`, and `QueryFramesInto` all return `errors.New("not implemented")`. Call sites were updated to use this stub (`parser.go: duckDB := NewInMemoryDB()` and `sql_command.go: db := sql.NewInMemoryDB()`), so any invocation of `TablesList` or `SQLCommand.Execute` will now fail at runtime. Additionally, `ReadQuery` now explicitly rejects `QueryTypeSQL` with `"sqlExpressions is not implemented"` via `enableSqlExpressions`, which currently always returns false. This is a concrete broken-behavior change, not just a speculative risk.
